rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a material diplomatic-letter template for the child. Both are addressed to a president, discuss the warm relationship between the two countries and peoples, and close with a closely parallel combination of high regard and personal wishes for the recipient's health and well-being. C13 and C12 contain portions of the same diplomatic closing formula, but their overall correspondence is less substantial.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am sure that the cordiality and warm regard ... between ... our two peoples [and their Chiefs of State] will long endure
shared_material.parent_excerpt: With the sincere hope for an increasingly warm and fruitful relationship between our two peoples and Governments
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the bilateral relationship as warm and enduring and expressly pair the two peoples with their governments or chiefs of state.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In transmitting to you my expressions of high esteem, I also assure you of my best wishes for your personal health and well-being
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I extend to you, Mr. President, the assurances of my highest consideration and my personal best wishes for your health and well-being
shared_material.explanation: This is a close and distinctive parallel in the concluding sentence, preserving the sequence of high diplomatic regard followed by personal wishes for health and well-being.
